integrity: Exact symbolic Fourier/fiber argument; finite reproducible numerical checks are explicitly subsidiary and do not establish infinite-dimensional claims.
mathematical_scope: Complex bilateral square-summable sequences with strictly positive checkerboard weights; all real parameters of the discrete fractional translation group.
scientific_limitations: No general periodic-weight or non-Hilbert exponent classification; no exhaustive historical priority proof. The 1977 Andersen full text was unavailable for direct comparison.
title: Exact norm profile and maximizers of a fractional translation group with checkerboard weights
